card.name: Measures or steps to control a problem
card.fires_on: The word "measures" or "steps" (and the "to" right after it) following verbs like institute, take or administer, just before a goal such as controlling or reducing something. Also "reason" in "for any reason".

modes.label: Measures/steps to act
modes.description: The noun measures or steps, or the "to" after it, introducing an action aimed at controlling a problem.
modes.example: initiate<< measures>> to control uric acid.

modes.label: For any reason
modes.description: The word reason in the phrase "for any reason" within a conditional clause.
modes.example: if, for any<< reason>>, cromolyn sodium inhalation

card.plain: It marks the point where the text says to take measures or steps to control or reduce a problem.
evidence: Administer multiple-dose oral activated charcoal and measures<< to>> control emesis.
